run.change_description:
feat(completion): support sourcing zsh completion dynamically

Summary:
Previously, you needed to save the completion script to a file and then
source it.  Now, you can dynamically source completions in zsh by
running

```zsh
$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)
```

Test plan:
1. Run `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`
2. Run `rg --generate=complete-zs<TAB>`

Before this commit, you would get an error after step 1.
After this commit, it should work as expected.

Closes #2956

improve FAQ text for zsh completions

summary.intent: Let zsh users load ripgrep completions with `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` instead of installing an `_rg` file on `fpath`, and document that option in the FAQ.
summary.issue_fit: Met for the code change — after `compinit`, sourcing registers `_rg` and no longer raises the `_arguments` error from #2956. The FAQ instructions have two small gaps.
summary.coverage: Complete diff of both files read. `rg.zsh` behaviour checked in scratch zsh 5.8.1 runs, and the `ci/test-complete` sourcing path was traced but not run.
check_details: Reviewer ran scratch zsh 5.8.1 scripts at the reviewed head: sourcing after `compinit` registers `_rg` (base still raises the #2956 error); the `fpath` autoload and `ci/test-complete`-style sourcing both work; sourcing before `compinit` prints `command not found: _arguments`.

`ci/test-complete` and `cargo build`/`cargo test` were unavailable (no built `rg`, no registry); the sourcing mechanism `ci/test-complete` uses was reproduced with a stub `_arguments`, so its option listing was not compared against `rg --help`.

findings.title: Drop the `$` prompt from the `.zshrc` snippet
findings.trigger: The text says to add the block to `$HOME/.zshrc`, but the block reads `$ source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`, and a reader copies it verbatim.
findings.impact: zsh reports `command not found: $` on every shell start and completions are never loaded; the neighbouring `fpath=` snippet correctly omits the prompt.
findings.change: In `FAQ.md`, change the line to `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)`.
findings.source: pr-body/"Now, you can dynamically source completions in zsh"

findings.title: Say the `source` line must follow `compinit`
findings.trigger: A reader adds the documented `source <(rg --generate complete-zsh)` line to a `.zshrc` above the `compinit` call, as many frameworks and dotfiles do.
findings.impact: With `compdef` undefined, `rg.zsh` runs `_rg` directly and prints `_rg:341: command not found: _arguments` on every shell start, and `rg` is never registered even after `compinit` runs.
findings.change: In `FAQ.md`, add a sentence after the `source` snippet saying it must come after `compinit` has run.

observations.fact: The new caveat sentence has no subject after "easier to setup," and uses "setup" as a verb.

requirements.source: pr-body/"you can dynamically source completions in zsh by running"
requirements.evidence: Scratch zsh run: compinit then `source <(cat rg.zsh)` gives `_comps[rg]=_rg` with no error; base gives the #2956 error. `crates/core/flags/complete/rg.zsh:441-445`.

Base run after compinit prints `_arguments:comparguments:325: can only be called from completion function`; head prints nothing. Sourcing before compinit still errors, as it did at base (see FAQ.md/zsh-source-needs-compinit).
An interactive TAB completion needs a built `rg` and a pty; only the registration `_comps[rg]=_rg` was observed.
